reviews.title: Great board!
reviews.comment: First build with AM5 and this board has been great, booted fine first try did not have the memory training issues I have heard others talk about. I did update the bios to the most recent not sure if that is what helped.
reviews.author: Richard Thurlow

reviews.title: Not Good For Price To Performance, Good For Performance
reviews.comment: It’s really good. I will admit, for an original price of $190, you’re better finding another motherboard. However, I found this for $120 refurbished and it works like it’s new. It’s easy to install in your case and won’t hold back any of your pcie 4 components. The software it came with was nice and easy to navigate. When I was trying to set up windows though, there wasn’t an explicit warning that I had to install the wifi drivers from elsewhere to even make it to the main windows screen. Beyond this, it’s great, functional, and it stays cool.
reviews.author: Jaden

reviews.title: De las mejores costo beneficio
reviews.comment: Costo beneficio muy bueno, no me funcionaba bien el bluetooth y trate de bajar los drivers por los canales oficiales pero me toco utilizar un programa adicional para poder acualizar todos los drivers y ahi funcionó perfectamente.  Llevo usandolo  3 semanas sin problema.
reviews.author: Juan F.

reviews.title: Buena Placa Base AM5
reviews.comment: Es buena, no viene en su caja original pero cumple con las expectativas para lo calidad - precio que es, ya que siendo un producto renovado/reacondicionado se mantiene en buen estado y puede durar bastante.
reviews.author: Avila_

reviews.title: My favorite PC hardware company
reviews.comment: IMO Gigabyte has the most reliable and the best user experience as far as motherboard software/driver acquisition among the board makers, easiest boards to update the bios on the method is intuitive and reliable! I've also found in general Gigabyte's prices are the best and carry the same amount of features as the others.
reviews.author: RealGamer83
